Overview

## Run Autonomous Agents More Safely {#run-autonomous-agents-more-safely .title}

[NVIDIA NemoClaw is an open source stack that adds privacy and security controls to OpenClaw. With one command, anyone can run always-on, self-evolving agents anywhere. Try NemoClaw now in early preview. ]{.p--large}

[NemoClaw uses [NVIDIA Agent Toolkit](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/ai-agents){target="_blank"} software to secure OpenClaw. It installs NVIDIA [OpenShell](http://build.nvidia.com/openshell){target="_blank"} to enforce policy-based privacy and security guardrails, giving users control over how agents behave and handle data. ]{.p--large}

[It also evaluates available compute resources to run high-performance open models like [NVIDIA Nemotron](https://developer.nvidia.com/nemotron){target="_blank"}™ locally for enhanced privacy and cost efficiency. ]{.p--large}

## Run Autonomous, Self-Evolving Agents More Safely, Instantly {#run-autonomous-self-evolving-agents-more-safely-instantly .cmp-teaser__title .h--smallest titlerow="One" titlerowlaptop="One" titlerowtablet="One"}

NVIDIA OpenShell is an open source runtime that enables autonomous agents to operate and adapt faster and more safely.

## Features {#features .title}

::: {#nv-image-07b3fe3441 .cmp-image .d-align-center .l-align-center .t-align-center .m-align-center asset="/content/dam/icons/m48-secure-data.svg" cmp-is="nv-image" cmp-lazy="" cmp-lazythreshold="300" cmp-src="/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/ai/nemoclaw/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_section/nv_container_section/nv_container_feature_card_1_1/nv_image_0.coreimg{.width}.svg/1774244510727/m48-secure-data.svg" cmp-type="renditionUpload" data-title="Safe process icon." itemscope="" itemtype="http://schema.org/ImageObject"}

### Run Claws More Safely {#run-claws-more-safely .title}

OpenClaw has become the operating system for personal AI. NemoClaw adds security and privacy controls, so developers can build and run AI assistants with more confidence, while also contributing to the [OpenClaw project](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw){target="_blank"}.

::: {#nv-image-943c7376ed .cmp-image .d-align-center .l-align-center .t-align-center .m-align-center asset="/content/dam/icons/m48-generative-and-agentic-ai.svg" cmp-is="nv-image" cmp-lazy="" cmp-lazythreshold="300" cmp-src="/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/ai/nemoclaw/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_section/nv_container_section/nv_container_feature_card_2_2/nv_image_3.coreimg{.width}.svg/1774244510815/m48-generative-and-agentic-ai.svg" cmp-type="renditionUpload" data-title="AI Coding agent icon." itemscope="" itemtype="http://schema.org/ImageObject"}

### Use Any Coding Agent {#use-any-coding-agent .title}

Tap open models like [NVIDIA Nemotron](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/foundation-models/nemotron/) locally on your dedicated system. A privacy router also connects agents to cloud-based frontier models, allowing agents to develop new skills within defined privacy and security guardrails. 

::: {#nv-image-0823250c89 .cmp-image .d-align-center .l-align-center .t-align-center .m-align-center asset="/content/dam/icons/m48-streaming-deployment.svg" cmp-is="nv-image" cmp-lazy="" cmp-lazythreshold="300" cmp-src="/content/nvidiaGDC/us/en_US/ai/nemoclaw/_jcr_content/root/responsivegrid/nv_container_section/nv_container_section/nv_container_feature_card_3_3/nv_image_6.coreimg{.width}.svg/1774244510903/m48-streaming-deployment.svg" cmp-type="renditionUpload" data-title="Deploy anywhere icon." itemscope="" itemtype="http://schema.org/ImageObject"}

### Deploy Anywhere {#deploy-anywhere .title}

Always-on agents need dedicated compute to run tools, write code, and complete tasks. NemoClaw provides local, 24/7 compute for autonomous agents on systems like [NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ PCs/laptops](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-on-rtx/), [NVIDIA RTX™ PRO workstations,](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/) and [NVIDIA DGX Station™](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/dgx-station/) or [DGX Spark™](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/dgx-spark/).
